messages:
ana: Quick kickoff  we need a concise benchmark narrative that sells latency + cost in dollars for the launch. Goal: hero visual + appendix + webinar.
tom: my 3 recommended visuals: 1) single scatter: p95 latency (ms) vs $/1k tokens (points per model+config), 2) waterfall showing stacking savings (batching, cache, quant), 3) stacked bar for typical sessions (search 150tks, chat 700tks) with $/session.
rachael: wording: hero headline: "Dollars you can plan for, latency you can trust." subhead: "See typical $/1k tokens for real workloads and how batching, caching, and Dedicated change the math." keep conservative claims.
design: animation idea  show waterfall layers applying one-by-one until cost collapses to final bar. muted palette, highlight our accent green. 20-25 frames GIF.
bench-bot: sample slices logged: search-short(128), chat-mid(700), retrieval-long(4096). CSV available at /shared/bench/4001234567/samples.csv
tom: inbound forms: ask monthly tokens, avg seq len, latency SLO, primary use case. route high-SLO (<200ms) or >50M tokens to enterprise. otherwise nurture. add utm_bench=dollars-latency.
rachael: webinar concept: "Plan your LLM bill: charts, demos, Q/A" format: 25m walkthrough, 20m live Q/A, 10m microbench demo. CTA: Register + upload a sample workload to get a personalized estimate.
growth-bot: will create nurture paths and draft 3 subject lines. also plan lead score tag "bench-highops" for enterprise routing.
ana: (typo) meant ana :D
design: deliverables checklist: hero mock, 30s GIF, chart CSV to viz, appendix slide templates. Deadline: Fri EOD for first pass.
tom: include a tiny reproducible snippet in the blog: 
``
bench run --model redwood-3b --seq 700 --batch 16 --cache warm
```
keep it short.
rachael: copy guardrails: avoid exact % claims. use ranges and link to methodology. example copy: "Typical cases: $X$Y per 1k tokens; see appendix for test harness."
bench-bot: reminder scheduled: final CSV upload at 4001234580.
ana: i'll own the asset tracker + Jira epic. tom: you own CSV + viz specs. rachael: webinar copy + email drafts. design: hero + gif. growth-bot: lead flows.
ana: thanks all  sync in #launchsprint tomorrow 11am to review assets.
